findings.title: robots.txt blocks crawlers from the entire site

suggested_action.summary: Remove the blanket Disallow rule (or scope it to genuinely private paths only) so AI/search crawlers can index the site at all.

findings.title: No JSON-LD structured data on the page
findings.evidence: 17/18 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://facebook.com/', 'https://facebook.com/recover/initiate?privacy_mutation_token=eyJ0eXBlIjo1LCJjcmVhdGlvbl90aW1lIjoxNzg4NjExMTU1fQ%3D%3D&ars=facebook_login', 'https://facebook.com/reg?entry_point=login']). Zero <script type="application/ld+json"> blocks found.

suggested_action.summary: Add schema.org JSON-LD (Organization on every page at minimum; Product/Article/LocalBusiness/FAQPage where relevant) so assistants can extract facts with certainty instead of inferring them from prose.
Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> — without it mobile visitors get a desktop-scaled layout and bounce quickly.

findings.title: No H1 heading
findings.evidence: 16/18 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://facebook.com/', 'https://facebook.com/recover/initiate?privacy_mutation_token=eyJ0eXBlIjo1LCJjcmVhdGlvbl90aW1lIjoxNzg4NjExMTU1fQ%3D%3D&ars=facebook_login', 'https://facebook.com/reg?entry_point=login']). Page has zero <h1> elements.

suggested_action.summary: Add exactly one clear <h1> stating the page's core topic — it's the strongest single outline signal an extractor uses.

findings.title: Thin visible text in raw HTML
findings.evidence: Only ~77 words of visible text found in the raw HTML response.

suggested_action.summary: Verify key facts (what the brand does, product details, pricing) are present as plain server-rendered text, not just implied by images or loaded asynchronously.

findings.title: No Organization/LocalBusiness entity markup to anchor identity
findings.evidence: No schema.org Organization or LocalBusiness JSON-LD block found.

suggested_action.summary: Add an Organization JSON-LD block with name, url, logo, and sameAs — without it there is no machine-readable anchor for 'who this brand is' at all.
Add a persistent navigation region with links to key sections (product, pricing, about, contact) so visitors — and agents browsing on a user's behalf — can orient and go deeper instead of leaving.

findings.title: No clear call-to-action found
findings.evidence: No button/link text matched common CTA phrasing (sign up, contact, buy, get started, book, subscribe, download, etc.).

suggested_action.summary: Add at least one prominent, specific call-to-action above the fold stating the next step you want a visitor to take.

findings.title: Missing meta description
findings.evidence: 9/18 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://facebook.com/', 'https://facebook.com/recover/initiate?privacy_mutation_token=eyJ0eXBlIjo1LCJjcmVhdGlvbl90aW1lIjoxNzg4NjExMTU1fQ%3D%3D&ars=facebook_login', 'https://facebook.com/reg?entry_point=login']). No <meta name="description"> content found.

suggested_action.summary: Add a concise (~150-160 char) meta description stating what the page/brand offers — assistants and search snippets draw on this.

findings.title: No contact phone or hours found in plain text
findings.evidence: 17/18 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://facebook.com/', 'https://facebook.com/recover/initiate?privacy_mutation_token=eyJ0eXBlIjo1LCJjcmVhdGlvbl90aW1lIjoxNzg4NjExMTU1fQ%3D%3D&ars=facebook_login', 'https://facebook.com/reg?entry_point=login']). No phone-number or opening-hours pattern detected in visible text.

suggested_action.summary: If applicable to this business, state phone/hours as plain text and in LocalBusiness JSON-LD — assistants answering 'is X open now / what's their number' need this in extractable form.

findings.title: JSON-LD block missing schema.org context
findings.evidence: 4/18 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://facebook.com/about', 'https://facebook.com/about', 'https://facebook.com/about']). @context = '' does not reference schema.org.

suggested_action.summary: Set "@context": "https://schema.org" so parsers recognize the vocabulary.

findings.title: Majority of images have no alt text
findings.evidence: 1/18 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://facebook.com/lite']). 4/4 elements have empty or missing alt attributes.

suggested_action.summary: Add descriptive alt text to informational images (not decorative ones) so any facts conveyed visually (diagrams, infographics, screenshots with data) have a text equivalent a machine can read.

findings.title: No freshness/last-updated signal found
findings.evidence: No article:modified_time meta tag, visible 'last updated' text, or Last-Modified header was found.

suggested_action.summary: For time-sensitive pages (pricing, listings, events, docs) add a visible 'last updated' date and an article:modified_time meta tag so assistants can judge recency before repeating claims.

findings.title: Corroboration research not performed for this run
findings.evidence: No --search-results input was supplied, so cross-source agreement for this brand's key claims was not evaluated.

suggested_action.summary: Have the calling agent web-search 3-5 of the page's key factual claims (founding date, HQ, pricing, leadership) and re-run this check with --search-results to score corroboration.

findings.title: Incomplete Open Graph tags
findings.evidence: 13/18 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://facebook.com/', 'https://facebook.com/recover/initiate?privacy_mutation_token=eyJ0eXBlIjo1LCJjcmVhdGlvbl90aW1lIjoxNzg4NjExMTU1fQ%3D%3D&ars=facebook_login', 'https://facebook.com/reg?entry_point=login']). og:title present=False, og:description present=False.

suggested_action.summary: Add og:title, og:description, and og:image so link previews and summarization tools have a clean, authoritative source to quote.

findings.title: Heading levels skip a level
findings.evidence: 3/18 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://facebook.com/lite', 'https://facebook.com/about', 'https://facebook.com/policies?ref=pf']). Heading sequence jumps by more than one level at least once (sequence found: [2, 4, 4, 4]).

suggested_action.summary: Keep heading levels sequential (h1 > h2 > h3, no skips) so tools that build an outline from headings don't misjudge structure.

findings.title: High proportion of page text is nav/footer/boilerplate
findings.evidence: 2/18 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://facebook.com/lite', 'https://facebook.com/pages/create?ref_type=site_footer']). Estimated 77% of visible text sits in nav/footer/menu/banner-like containers.

suggested_action.summary: Trim repeated navigation/footer/cookie text relative to main content, or ensure the main content region is marked with <main>/semantic tags so extractors can weight it appropriately.

findings.title: No <main> landmark element
findings.evidence: 18/18 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://facebook.com/', 'https://facebook.com/recover/initiate?privacy_mutation_token=eyJ0eXBlIjo1LCJjcmVhdGlvbl90aW1lIjoxNzg4NjExMTU1fQ%3D%3D&ars=facebook_login', 'https://facebook.com/reg?entry_point=login']). No <main> tag found; the primary-content region isn't explicitly marked.

suggested_action.summary: Wrap the core content in a <main> element (even if boilerplate ratio is currently fine) — it's a cheap, unambiguous signal for extractors and accessibility tools to weight the right region as the page's substance, and protects against boilerplate creeping in as the page grows.

findings.title: Consider an explicit one-line summary near the top
findings.evidence: 9/18 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://facebook.com/', 'https://facebook.com/reg?entry_point=login', 'https://facebook.com/reg']). Opening content passed the filler/concrete check (68 words in the lead), but no distinct single-sentence summary/TL;DR was specifically detected.

suggested_action.summary: Even with concrete opening content, adding one explicit summary sentence right after the H1 (e.g. 'X is a Y that does Z for W') gives assistants a ready-made, quotable answer for 'what is this' style questions instead of having to synthesize one.
